data.name: NotConfigured
data.value: Sending mail is not set up yet.

data.name: AuthenticationFailed
data.value: Login to the mail server failed – check username and password.

data.name: CertificateNameMismatch
data.value: The mail server’s certificate is valid for “{0}”, not for “{1}” – enter that name as the server.

data.name: SslHandshakeFailed
data.value: Secure connection to the mail server failed – check encryption and port (465 = SSL/TLS, 587 = STARTTLS).

data.name: Unreachable
data.value: Mail server not reachable – check server and port.

data.name: Rejected
data.value: The mail server rejected the mail: {0}

data.name: UnexpectedResponse
data.value: Unexpected response from the mail server – check server, port and encryption.

data.name: ConnectionLost
data.value: Connection to the mail server was lost – check server, port and encryption.

data.name: InvalidSettings
data.value: Invalid settings – enter only the name as the server (no port, no https://).
